panel.selection_rule: lexicographically next task id after W4407227665 that exists in all eight fixed model trajectory directories, resolved from existence-only public metadata before opening any trajectory body

coding_rule_frozen.severe_self_critique: yes only when the trajectory explicitly recognizes a load-bearing flaw that materially threatens its retained scientific conclusion under the existing evidence; no/no-observed is not proof of scientific validity
coding_rule_frozen.closure: yes only when the issue is closed by an evidence-changing discriminating repair, a material claim downgrade propagated to the load-bearing claim surfaces, or a hard block/rejection; caveat prose alone is not closure; later severe issues reopen the gate
coding_rule_frozen.repair_pending: yes only when an unresolved severe issue is durably represented at termination as a machine-actionable next-run obligation rather than ordinary prose

panel.scope_guard: single preregistered common-task failure-pattern probe only; not a population prevalence estimate or model ranking
